title: Direct Salts Pineapple Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Direct Salts Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid offers a brilliant balance of exotic fruit warmth and crisp winter chill. The profile leads with the distinct, mouth-watering tang and rich sweetness of ripe Pineapple, creating a vibrant tropical inhale. To complete the experience, a smooth layer of crisp Ice washes over the palate on the exhale. This combination delivers a thoroughly uplifting and highly tropical vaping experience. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Direct Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Direct Salts collection offers vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and confectionery profiles. Providing a highly cost-effective and flexible option, this 10ml range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the chilled tropical notes of Pineapple Ice, vapers can explore other compelling options such as the classic Menthol, the nostalgic Cherry Cola, or the balanced Strawberry Kiwi.
